executiveSummary: Edge-access device exploitation and OT gateway vulnerabilities remain the most credible near-term paths to operational disruption. Multiple actively exploited VPN/ADC gateways (Ivanti Connect Secure, Citrix NetScaler, SonicWall SMA) and two CISA weekly bulletins with critical OT gateway issues (Advantech) elevate risk of IT-to-OT pivots. A coordinated cyberattack in France manipulated supermarket refrigeration OT across hundreds of stores, confirming real-world cyber-physical impact. Ivanti Connect Secure authentication-bypass (CVE-2026-104935) is under active exploitation; CISA added it to KEV and urges immediate patching, rebuilds, and credential rotation. Security Advisory View Article Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE and DoS vulnerabilities are being exploited in the wild; CERT-FR provides hunting artifacts and Mandiant/GTIG IOCs, while CISA added a NetScaler flaw to KEV. Security Advisory KEV Update Advantech industrial protocol gateways (EKI-1242EIMS/IEIMS) expose multiple pre-auth command execution and missing-auth paths; additional OT-adjacent issues (WISE-6610, AVEVA PIM, eProsima DDS) were flagged in CISA weekly bulletins. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin Coordinated attacks in France raised refrigeration setpoints across major supermarket chains; BSI warns small/very small operators (refrigeration, inverters, water points) about exposed OT interfaces. Supporting Report View Article CISA red-teaming at a Water/Wastewater utility demonstrated realistic IT-to-OT pivot via a bastion host; hardened identity, segmentation, and token hygiene are emphasized. Security Advisory High-severity improper authorization in Inductive Automation Ignition enables Designer-level code execution on gateways; patch to 8.1.55/8.3.9 and restrict gateway exposure. ICS Advisory

items: State-linked ecosystem: Joint US/Allied advisory details PRC-linked operators leveraging botnets, VPN infrastructure, and LOTL techniques against U.S. CI sectors, indicating persistent interest in CI footholds. Security Advisory

ShinyHunters data-extortion: Continued law-enforcement action; mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) with WAF-bypass observed in campaigns impacting aviation and government. View Article
Crimeware: MovieReaper torrent-based campaign with Solana-backed C2; lateral movement risk to CI enterprises via infected endpoints. Vendor Research
Ransomware tradecraft: GPO weaponization for "PAYLOAD" extortion effects at a manufacturing firm bypassed file-based detections via trusted AD/SYSVOL mechanisms. Incident Report

relevance: Risk this week concentrates on: (1) compromise of perimeter remote-access and ADC devices commonly brokering connectivity into sensitive networks; (2) exploitable industrial protocol gateways (Advantech) that directly bridge field protocols (Modbus/OPC UA) to IP networks; and (3) confirmed cyber-physical tampering in retail refrigeration. High-severity HMI/SCADA vulnerabilities (Inductive Ignition) and enterprise Windows zero-days reinforce the IT-to-OT pivot risk where operator/engineering assets and historians run on Windows.

items: Advantech EKI-1242EIMS/IEIMS protocol gateways: unauthenticated command execution; missing auth for critical mgmt; OPC UA DoS; firmware signing gaps. CISA Bulletin
Advantech WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways: remote command injection (public exploits). CISA Bulletin
Inductive Automation Ignition (8.1.0-8.1.54, 8.3.0-8.3.8): improper authorization to Designer-level code execution; patch to 8.1.55/8.3.9+. ICS Advisory
SAP Patch Day: critical issues incl. SAP MII; immediate patching advised. View Article
Metabase unauth SQLi actively exploited; admin takeover observable in logs; patch or block reset endpoint. Security Advisory
Swann SWIFI-SE2KIC cameras: missing auth allows local-network video access; segment and update. ICS Advisory

descriptions: Initial Access via Edge Devices: Exploitation of VPN/ADC gateways (Ivanti, NetScaler, SMA) [ATT&CK T1190, T1133]. Security Advisory
Privilege Escalation & Lateral Movement: ADCS ESC1 certificate abuse, DCSync, Seamless SSO misuse, and token abuse in hybrid cloud/AD. [T1550, T1558, T1552]. Security Advisory
Defense Evasion via GPO Weaponization: Domain-root GPO changes to deliver extortion effects; trusted SYSVOL pathways. [T1484.001, T1112]. Incident Report
Web App Exploitation: Unauth SQLi for Metabase admin takeover; WAF-bypass via URL-encoding for PeopleSoft. [T1190, T1059]. Security Advisory
OT Gateway Compromise: Pre-auth command injection/missing auth to reconfigure protocol gateways and bridge OT/IT. [ICS ATT&CK: Inhibit Response Function, Modify Control Logic]. CISA Bulletin

outlook72h: Expect continued scanning and exploitation attempts against vulnerable Ivanti, NetScaler, and SonicWall gateways; prioritize remediation windows and pre-patch compromise checks. Monitor for opportunistic targeting of exposed OT controllers (refrigeration/BMS) following France incidents; proactively remove public exposure and enforce MFA/IP allowlists. Track for exploitation of Advantech ICS gateways and related OT middleware; deploy industrial firewalls and NIDS signatures on OT boundaries. Accelerate validation/rollout of Windows and Ignition patches on OT-adjacent systems during maintenance windows. Harden WAF/API gateways against Metabase SQLi patterning and PeopleSoft encoding-bypass TTPs; hunt logs for historical indicators since June 2026.
